evals.prompt: Turn research about interrupted identity checks into an end-to-end interaction design before engineering starts.
assertions: Pins the user need, whole journey, desired outcome, constraints, source evidence, exclusions, and unresolved assumptions
Models normal, exceptional, interrupted, recovery, accessibility, content, and channel states rather than drawing only a happy path
Compares alternatives and defines focused prototype questions without treating the design as approved implementation

evals.prompt: We have three checkout flows and a week to decide. Choose prototype fidelity and an evaluation approach.
assertions: Matches prototype fidelity to the structural, comprehension, or interaction uncertainty being tested
Defines representative participants, realistic tasks, observable success, confounds, and retain/revise/reject evidence
Synthesizes results against exact artifact revisions and preserves prototype limitations

evals.prompt: Prepare the UX handoff for a tested account-recovery design to product, development, QA, accessibility, and operations.
assertions: Provides the tested revision, rationale, state and content inventory, accessibility requirements, evidence, limitations, and open questions
Keeps stories, test strategy, analytics implementation, and release approval with their owning capabilities
Defines how material implementation deviations update the design decision and remain traceable
